name: MPX
description: Modular Polyphonic Expression: one cable carries a whole instrument, and every note on it keeps its own pitch, level, duration, pan, bend, pressure and timbre.
author: Chris Graham

modules.name: mpxIn
modules.description: Gathers ordinary control voltages into voice cables. Gate, pitch, level, duration, pan, pressure and timbre go in as polyphonic signals, and four voice cables come out, each carrying one instrument's notes. Pitch, level, duration and pan are read at the gate's rising edge and held for the note's life; bend, pressure and timbre are followed while it sounds. The notes-per-voice knob decides how the sixteen channels divide among the four cables.

modules.name: mpxOut
modules.description: Takes one voice cable apart into ordinary polyphonic control voltages: gate, pitch, level, bend as a control signal and as volts per octave, pressure, timbre, pan and duration. It allocates the notes among its voices, with a choice of what gives when none is free: take the oldest, take the quietest, ignore the note, glide, or legato.

modules.name: mpxMonitor
modules.description: Shows what is on an MPX cable and passes it on unchanged: the harmony being played against, and the notes going by with their pitch, level and duration. An MPX cable carries no voltage, so a scope says nothing about it and this is the way to see one.

modules.name: mpxChart
modules.description: Reads iReal Pro playlists and plays their charts onto an MPX cable. Import an HTML export once and the songs are yours to choose from; the chosen one is stored in the patch itself, so it opens on a machine that has never seen your playlists. Repeats, endings and similes are written out and the chart is shown as it is played, four bars to a line, with the sounding bar picked out. Transposes with one knob, since chords are held as degrees of the key.

modules.name: mpxChordVoicing
modules.description: Decides where the notes of the chord on an MPX cable go — how many voices, where they sit, how far apart and how little they move — and publishes that voicing for everything downstream

modules.name: polyToStereo
modules.description: A channel strip per voice: two level stages multiplied, a pan, and a stereo pair

modules.name: mpxArp
modules.description: An arpeggiator on the chord from the cable, with a length that can be pushed into overlap

modules.name: mpxRand
modules.description: Varies one attribute of an MPX cable's notes — duration, level, pan, timing or tuning — by white, walk or Perlin randomness

modules.name: mpxPattern
modules.description: A rhythm written as text: where the notes fall, how strong each is and how high it aims, each row cycling at its own length; it chooses no pitches, which mpxMelody does from the harmony

modules.name: mpxMelody
modules.description: Master for a melody chain: how far the voices keep apart, the random seed they share, and the chart they are played against. Voice expanders make the sound

modules.name: mpxVoice
modules.description: One melodic line drawn against the harmony on the cable — bass, melody or inner voice. Sits beside mpxMelody

modules.name: mpxSprites
modules.description: Sprites move over a picture, pushed about by a force field read from its colours, each sending notes as it goes; the picture is on the panel and the motion is watched as well as heard

modules.name: mpxPathSprites
modules.description: Eight reading heads running drawn lines and circles over a picture; what each passes over becomes a voltage — a drawn LFO, or at speed a wavetable oscillator

modules.name: mpxPathSpritePlayer
modules.description: Eight sprites running drawn paths over a picture, playing the notes a rhythm asks for: the pitch from the chord sounding then, placed by what the sprite is passing over

modules.name: mpxPiano
modules.description: The Salamander Grand Piano by Alexander Holm, played from an MPX cable.

modules.name: mpxGuitarChart12
modules.description: Deprecated: use mpxScore, which reads the same files and has six or twelve rows. Kept so that patches made with this module still open.

modules.name: mpxGuitarChart6
modules.description: Deprecated: use mpxScore, which reads the same files and has six or twelve rows. Kept so that patches made with this module still open.

modules.name: mpxScore
modules.description: Plays a score — MusicXML or Guitar Pro — with each part on its own MPX cable with a mute and a gain, six or twelve rows from the menu, a built-in General MIDI band on a stereo mix, and a continuous engraved view with a playhead and bars to loop.

modules.name: mpxGuitar
modules.description: Plays one MPX part on a modelled guitar, nylon, steel-string or electric: waveguide strings picked, hammered, slid, palm-muted, bent and touched for harmonics as the part says, through an acoustic body or a pickup and amplifier, in stereo.

modules.name: mpxFingerPicker
modules.description: Plays the chords on an mpxChart cable finger-style: a folk picking pattern on the chart's beat, the thumb on the bass and the fingers on the treble strings, each note sent with its string and fret for mpxGuitar.

modules.name: mpxGuitarArticulation
modules.description: Plays one MPX part through any polyphonic oscillator: a pitch output with the bends in it, the oscillator's audio coming back through each string's own envelope and level, panned and mixed to stereo.

modules.name: mpxGuitarChartExpander
modules.description: Placed to the right of mpxGuitarChart, plays all twelve of its tracks through FluidSynth on the instruments the file names. An audio output and a gain for each track, and the whole band as a stereo pair.

modules.name: mpxFluidSynth
modules.description: A SoundFont band: six MPX parts through one FluidSynth and one bank, a channel per string so bends and legato behave, with the bank's own sounds chosen per part.

modules.name: mpxGuitarist
modules.description: Plays an articulated MPX part as control voltage — a channel per string, with the bends, slides, hammer-ons, palm mutes and vibrato already in the pitch, the gate and the level. Any voice in the rack can then play a guitar part.
